svg.title: Прогулка в гору с рюкзаком — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Hiking uphill in side profile with a clearly visible backpack secured by two shoulder straps. Continuous ground line visibly slopes uphill, no machine or stairs. Two different walking gait phases, loaded foot contact and opposite leg swinging, hands empty. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
